'''Supreme Commander''' was the title given to the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] learned that the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] intended to [[Emperor's ritual crisis|consume all life]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and that the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] was aiding Imperial forces on the [[Battle of Corellia|embattled]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] appointed the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] as Supreme Commander of all Jedi forces on the planet.
